collection.title: Maserati Gransport 2004 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Maserati Gransport 2004 to 2009 model which requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
